usage: PROG publish-language-splits [-h] [--data-root DATA_ROOT]
 [--dataset-version {v1,v2,both}]
 [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE]
 [--confirm-repo REPO_ID]
 [--apply | --dry-run] [--hf-token HF_TOKEN]
 [--log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}]

options:
 -h, --help show this help message and exit
 --data-root DATA_ROOT Data root directory
 --dataset-version {v1,v2,both}
 Select language-split contracts to publish (default: both)
 --batch-size BATCH_SIZE Rows to stream per input batch (default: 65536)
 --confirm-repo REPO_ID Exact target repo id; repeat once per selected dataset
 --apply Publish and verify
 --dry-run Validate inventories and print the publication plan without writing or
 uploading
 --hf-token HF_TOKEN
 --log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}
